dict.Dosarele arhivei firmei: ce conține fiec: The company archive files: what each contains, the year, how many years it is kept and where it is stored; you get the year from which it can be disposed of, the files to dispose of (in red), those without a retention period (in yellow), those kept (in green) and how many pages are in the archive.
dict.Eliminarea se face cu proces-verbal; apo: Disposal is done with a written report; then enter “Yes” under Disposed.
dict.Termene uzuale: documentele contabile 5: Usual periods: accounting documents 5 years, the journal and inventory 10 years, payrolls 50 years.
dict.Un dosar se poate elimina de la 1 ianuar: A file can be disposed of from 1 January after its year plus the retention years.
